sec-head.h2: What does a RAG developer do?

p: A RAG developer designs and builds retrieval-augmented generation systems: pipelines that retrieve relevant information from a knowledge base and use it to ground an LLM's responses. This includes document ingestion and chunking, embedding model selection, vector database setup, retrieval logic, guardrail design, and production deployment. A freelance RAG developer delivers a working, integrated system, not just a proof-of-concept.
